name: Dual Monitor Workspaces
author: Gavin Hayes (LinuxGamerUK)
description: Persistent numbered workspace banks: 1-5 on the first monitor, 6-10 on the second. SUPER+SHIFT+N sends windows across screens. No external Hyprland plugin required.

barWidget.description: Numbered per-screen workspace banks (1-5 first monitor, 6-10 second) with persistent Hyprland workspace rules

schema.label: Workspaces per monitor bank
schema.description: Bank 1 (first monitor) covers 1..perBank, bank 2 (second monitor) covers perBank+1..2*perBank. Changing this also requires re-running the plugin's scripts/install.sh.
